name: Stock Ledger
query:
SELECT 
    name AS "SLE:Link/Stock Ledger Entry:120",
    posting_date AS "Date:Date:100",
    item AS "Item:Link/Item:120",
    warehouse AS "Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:150",
    qty AS "Qty:Float:100",
    rate AS "Rate:Currency:100",
    SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY item, warehouse ORDER BY posting_date, name) AS "Cumulative Qty:Float:120",
    stock_entry AS "Stock Entry:Link/Stock Entry:120"
FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry`
WHERE docstatus = 1
ORDER BY posting_date ASC, name ASC
